title: 2839. Check if Strings Can be Made Equal With Operations I

examples.explanation: We can do the following operations on s1: - Choose the indices i = 0, j = 2. The resulting string is s1 = "cbad". - Choose the indices i = 1, j = 3. The resulting string is s1 = "cdab" = s2.
It is not possible to make the two strings equal.
